rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for feeling lightheaded, unbalanced, or giddy.

example.english: I'm still dizzy after riding the roller coaster.
example.traditional: 我坐完過山車仲頭暈緊。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zo6 jyun4 gwo3 saan1 ce1 zung6 tau4 wan4 gan2

rows.note: Use this shorter form when the context is clear, sometimes suggesting stronger dizziness or that you may faint.

example.english: I'm so dizzy I can hardly stand.
example.jyutping: wan4 dou3 kei5 m4 wan2 laa3
